title: Impossible travel detected for user k.novak
description: Two successful sign-ins for k.novak@corp.example were observed three minutes apart, geolocating to Berlin and Amsterdam respectively. Both authentications used a managed device and satisfied MFA. Both source addresses fall within 192.0.2.0/24, which the asset inventory records as the corporate VPN egress pool; this pool rotates exit nodes between European regions.

indicators.context: Corporate VPN egress address recorded in asset inventory
